description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application implementing a Tic Tac Toe game. It manages the UI components, user interactions, game state rendering, and integrates with the game logic through the TicTacToeGame class. The activity handles modes (PvP and PvC), displays scores, manages the game board, and updates game status messages.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class controlling the UI and user interaction for the Tic Tac Toe game.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, binds view references, and sets default game mode.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Finds and sets click listeners for UI components like score displays, mode buttons, reset button, and board cells.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Configures the game mode (PvP or PvC), resets the board, and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateModeButtons
methods.description: Updates the visual state of mode selection buttons based on current mode.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles user taps on board cells, updates game state, and triggers computer move if applicable.

methods.name: maybeTriggerComputerMoveIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates the computer's move in PvC mode, with a simulated delay.

methods.name: renderAll
methods.description: Updates scores, board, status messages, and mode button states.

methods.name: renderScores
methods.description: Displays current game scores in the UI.

methods.name: renderBoard
methods.description: Updates the visual state of board buttons, highlighting winning lines.

methods.name: renderStatus
methods.description: Displays game status, including current turn, winner, or draw.
